description: This file defines the RetrieveThingResponse class, which models the response to a retrieve-thing command within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for creating, parsing, and managing the JSON representation of the response, as well as accessors for the retrieved 'Thing' entity and associated metadata.

classes.name: RetrieveThingResponse
classes.description: Represents the response to a RetrieveThing command, encapsulating the retrieved Thing data, HTTP status, headers, and JSON representation, with factory methods for creation from various data formats.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory methods for creating RetrieveThingResponse instances from ThingId, Thing, JSON string, or JSON object, with deprecated overloads for string-based ThingId.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an instance of RetrieveThingResponse from a JSON string or JSON object, extracting necessary fields and handling absent fields.

methods.name: getThing
methods.description: Returns the retrieved Thing as a model object.

methods.name: getEntityPlainString
methods.description: Returns the plain JSON string of the Thing entity.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Returns the JSON object representing the retrieved Thing, respecting schema version.

methods.name: setEntity
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified JSON entity.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with updated headers.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer resource path (empty in this case).

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Appends the response payload to a JSON builder, respecting schema version and predicate.
